snippet.title: Shatter Remastered Deluxe - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Relive the award-winning classic that redefined a genre. Now available on PC, PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One & Nintendo Switch.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1937230/Shatter_Remastered_Deluxe/
Buy on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10000753
Buy on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/shatter-remastered-deluxe/9PBZ6RSFR471
Buy on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/shatter-remastered-deluxe-switch/

Shatter returns in stunning 4K resolution running at 120fps, with a modernised UI, and multiple visual improvements. Re-experience the highly acclaimed original soundtrack, remixed and remastered in 5.1 surround sound.
